story_background.theme: The Temporal Rift on the Titanic
story_background.role: You are a team of time travelers.
story_background.goal: Before the ship sinks, find 5 missing 'temporal coordinate fragments'.

challenges.title: Challenge 1: Purser's Office (Find the Anomaly)
challenges.story: You've just boarded and been caught as stowaways. On the desk is a stack of passenger registration cards. You must identify the 'forged' card among them.
challenges.task: Out of the following 6 passenger cards, which one is statistically impossible?
challenges.hint: GM Hint: Refer to the box plot above. The forged card has a fare that doesn't match its class - either much higher or much lower than typical for that class. Players should compare each card's fare with the distribution shown in the chart for that card's class.
challenges.answer: The forged card: 3rd class (Pclass=3) but paying £3.51, which is much lower than typical 3rd class fares (£4.01-69.55).

challenges.title: Challenge 2: Echoes of the Passengers (Timeline Synchronization)
challenges.story_intro: Time ripples carry brief echoes of five travelers aboard the Titanic. Align their moments to restore the timeline.

echoes.text: Lanterns sway as the deck tilts; Parrish steadies a stranger amid rising alarm.
In the final chaos, Elias finds space in a lifeboat and slips into the night.
O'Sullivan boards at Queenstown (Q); a third-class ticket rustles in hand.
Sirayanian boards at Cherbourg (C); a third-class ticket rustles in hand.
Giles boards at Southampton (S); a second-class ticket rustles in hand.

known_facts: Boarding order by port: Southampton (S) → Cherbourg (C) → Queenstown (Q).
Phrases like 'boarded at' are before the iceberg impact.
Words like 'tilted', 'helping', or 'chaos' are after impact but still onboard.
challenges.task: Arrange the echoes (A–E) in correct chronological order.
challenges.explanation: Boarding echoes come first and follow port order S → C → Q; post-impact echoes (tilted/helping/chaos) follow; the lifeboat escape is last.

challenges.title: Decipher the Lifeboat Code
challenges.story: The lifeboat lock requires a 4-digit code based on passengers' survival predictions.
challenges.instructions: Predict which of the 4 passengers survived (1) or perished (0). Use the survival clues provided.

static_clues.heading: Survival Probability: Sex vs. Pclass
static_clues.content: Female (Class 1): 96.8%; Female (Class 2): 92.1%; Female (Class 3): 50.0%; Male (Class 1): 36.9%; Male (Class 2): 15.7%; Male (Class 3): 13.5%

challenges.title: Guest from the Deep
challenges.story:
The Captain has called you and your group to the deck of the ship with an 
    urgent mission. Telegrams have been intercepted from the ship's Marconi machine
    and it appears there is a stowaway on board! Unfortunately, the dastardly 
    stowaway has managed to scramble one of the telegrams using a mysterious code. 
    The Captain has created a list of 10 suspects. Can you decipher the letter and
    obtain the identity of the suspect before they get away?!
challenges.instructions: Decode the encrypted letter and select the name from the list of suspects.
challenges.intercepted_letter:
R.M.S. TITANIC
MARCONI WIRELESS SERVICE
APRIL 12, 1912

Good afternoon, I have snuck aboard this mighty vessel.
Now time to implement my darstardly plan!
Yours Sincerely,

A Guest of the Deep
